_comment: What Jev reads about each paid option (policy.models[*].good_at/weak_at/cost/measured), jev-prompt-v2 (2026-11-03). Rules, checked by descriptionProblems in lib/jev.mjs and by test/profiles.test.mjs: no model names, no digits, no negations, no reference to another option; each option is described on its own. Source: Artificial Analysis at the variant matching the effort the router actually sends (deepseek-v4.1-flash at high; mimo-v2.6-pro in its only mode); the glm-5.3-flash, qwen3.8-flash and muse-spark rows exist only at max/xhigh, hence 'measured at its top setting'. Lead's readings: deepseek-v4.1-flash high intelligence 29, agentic coding 29%, SWE 17%, agentic work 68% (highest), fastest; mimo-v2.6-pro agentic coding 35% (highest real), SWE 24%, slow start (3.5 s, 44 tok/s), hallucinates on knowledge; glm-5.3-flash coding 33% at max, 75 tok/s; qwen3.8-flash coding 25%, hallucinates most (-12); muse-spark non-hallucination +26 (highest), coding 8%; gpt-6-luna high coding 5% (lowest; hidden from Jev, jev.hidden). Cost words from the Go list output price per 1M tokens (docs/NOTES-pricing-2026-10-26.md in warslop): up to $0.25 cheapest (muse 0.20), up to $0.65 standard (deepseek 0.60 off-peak, glm 0.50, qwen 0.47, luna 0.50), above that pricier (mimo 0.87). Revision 2 (after the first jev-eval run): muse was over-picked for quick facts, proofs, puzzles and long documents, so its good_at is narrowed to specialist knowledge and its weak_at names its slowness on every request; deepseek's good_at names quick everyday questions, maths and reasoning.

ocpaid/opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.good_at: quick answers at high speed, everyday questions, maths and reasoning, long documents and long conversations, multi-step agentic work with tools, everyday coding
ocpaid/opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.weak_at: deep software engineering on large codebases

ocpaid/opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-pro.good_at: agentic coding and software engineering: multi-step coding, debugging and repository work with tools; long documents
ocpaid/opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-pro.weak_at: slow to start and slow to write; recalling facts from memory, where it tends to invent details

ocpaid/opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash.good_at: coding and debugging, with quick output

ocpaid/opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash.good_at: general tasks and everyday coding, reading images
ocpaid/opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash.weak_at: factual accuracy, where it often invents facts; hard multi-step reasoning

ocpaid/opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contri.good_at: specialist knowledge questions in law, medicine and science, where care matters above speed; it admits uncertainty readily
ocpaid/opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contri.weak_at: slow on every request, since it thinks before each answer; quick questions, puzzles and proofs, long documents, coding and tool tasks

ocpaid/opencode-go/gpt-6-luna.weak_at: coding, tool use and hard reasoning
